item.title: Water
item.description: ...Water This article is about water as a consumable. See water sport for activities in bodies of water. The quality and availability of drinking water vary between countries and regions. As a general rule, clean water is more difficult to get in hot weather, at low-income destinations and outside settlements. See dehydration for problems when the body becomes short of water. item.title: Morne Trois Pitons National Park
item.description: ...water falls and lakes with crystal clear water. History The national park was just a forest area in 1940, since 1952 a forest reserve and since 1975 a national park — the first one on Dominica. In 1997 UNESCO declared the park a world heritage site. Today Morne Trois Pitons comprises an area of 6800 hectares, six signposted hiking paths complete with picnic sites and rain covers.
